description: GPL-3 stream deck software for Elgato-style stream controllers (including the FIFINE AmpliGame D6 via a third-party device plugin).
notes: Portable install: the MSI is a WiX wrapper around a plain file-drop (no services or registry entries).
The FIFINE AmpliGame D6 needs a separate device plugin (opendeck-fifine-d6) installed via OpenDeck's Plugins -> Install from file.
pre_install: # The MSI extracts to PFiles/OpenDeck (WiX maps its Program Files folder to PFiles/).
# Flatten that up into $dir so opendeck.exe and its bundled starterpack plugin sit at the top.
